text:
Timing: 0:50

Talk track:
Explain the full target lineage. CT volumes were segmented into the four bones in 3D Slicer, assisted by TotalSegmentator and surface smoothing, then exported as STL meshes. Each surface was transformed into one common LPS grid and voxelised as a separate binary channel. These masks supervise decoder training and act as the held-out reference for Dice and ASSD. State the annotation-validation limitation clearly.

text:
Timing: 1:00

Talk track:
Explain ConvNeXt from left to right. The stem and downsampling stages create four feature resolutions. Inside each block, depthwise convolution captures spatial context, one-by-one layers mix channels, GELU adds non-linearity and the residual path stabilises learning. The project extracts these feature pyramids independently from AP and lateral DRRs before fusion.

Fold 4 had the weakest cross-view evidence and the lowest absolute Dice for every arm, so it exposed a shared-front-end quality ceiling. The fold was not discarded.
